_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 37c80e59: an unbound SPARQL function argument is an evaluation error (SPARQL 1.1 §17.3), STR takes any expression, a BIND primitive is substituted into EXISTS / LATERAL but not into a join operand. Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> ` (ITRV §A44/§A104). Anchors are CODE lines only — the fix's comments may be reworded freely. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: FilterExecutor — the shared argument helpers, IN, the async function path, exo:byUUID. Anchors are code lines of the shipped fix (ems__Bug 37c80e59, PR #4580): rewriting one of them means moving its anchor and re-taking every `expect` from a finished driver run — pairwise-distinct sets stay required.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/executors/FilterExecutor.ts

M1_getStringValue_empty_string._note: getStringValue turns an unbound argument back into "" (the defect, mechanism 1).

M2_getTerm_nonvariable_undefined._note: getTermFromExpression again sees only a variable: STR("ab"), STR(LCASE(?l)) get nothing (the defect, mechanism 2).

M5_byUUID_no_unbound_check._note: exo:byUUID loses its own contract and reaches the shared unbound error. Type-preserving: an impossible condition.

M6_getTerm_unbound_passes._note: An unbound variable reaches the term functions as undefined again: !isLiteral(?unbound) / sameTerm(?u1, ?u2) are true.
M6_getTerm_unbound_passes.from: if (term === undefined || term === null) throw new FilterExecutorError("unbound argument");
M6_getTerm_unbound_passes.to: if (term === null) throw new FilterExecutorError("unbound argument");

M8_in_sync_error_propagates._note: Synchronous IN: an erroring element raises at once — a later match no longer absorbs it (§17.4.1.9).

M9_in_async_error_propagates._note: The async twin of M8 (an EXISTS in the IN list).

M10_wrap_unbound_as_empty._note: The async function path turns an unbound argument into "" again (the async twin of M1).
M10_wrap_unbound_as_empty.from: return { type: "literal", value: undefined } as unknown as Expression;
M10_wrap_unbound_as_empty.to: return { type: "literal", value: "" } as unknown as Expression;

M14_logical_sync_error_propagates._note: PRE-EXISTING code, not the fix: `||` / `&&` lose their error tolerance (§17.4.1.5) on the synchronous path. Proves the no-regression axes U3 / T2 are not vacuous — the fix makes MORE operands raise, so a disjunction over an erroring operand is exactly what it must keep answering.

M15_no_iri_branch._note: The substituted-IRI branch is gone: `{ type: "iri" }` raises "Unsupported expression type" again, and now that getTermFromExpression evaluates non-variable arguments, !isLiteral(?s) over a substituted ?s drops every row (the regression the review found).

M18_getTerm_unbound_only_variable._note: Only an unbound VARIABLE raises in getTermFromExpression; an unbound non-variable argument (COALESCE(?unbound)) reaches the term functions as undefined again.
M18_getTerm_unbound_only_variable.from: if (term === undefined || term === null) throw new FilterExecutorError("unbound argument");
M18_getTerm_unbound_only_variable.to: if ((term === undefined || term === null) && varExpr.type === "variable") throw new FilterExecutorError("unbound argument");

M19_logical_async_error_propagates._note: PRE-EXISTING code, not the fix: the asynchronous `||` / `&&` (an EXISTS operand) lose their error tolerance (§17.4.1.5). Proves U3b is not vacuous — the async twin of M14.
